svg.title: Maestro: you conduct, AI agents play
svg.desc: An open-source AI-SDLC practice. You sit at the centre and orchestrate specialist AI agents for planning, building, testing, reviewing, debugging and documentation. Teams can shape the workflows to fit their own system.
